# WorkBuddy

> WorkBuddy puts local service businesses on page one of Google Search, Google Maps and AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI answers), so the people in their town already looking for what they do find them first and call them directly. The Page One Package is $297 a month with no contract and no setup fee.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://getworkbuddy.com/): What WorkBuddy does, the four services, real client results and how it works
- [Google Maps](https://getworkbuddy.com/google-maps): Google Business Profile management, weekly posts, review replies and review requests
- [Search & AI](https://getworkbuddy.com/seo): Local SEO, a page for every service, a new article every week, and AI search setup
- [Website](https://getworkbuddy.com/website): A fast website built to rank, owned by the business from day one
- [Calls & leads](https://getworkbuddy.com/leads): Instant text replies to website leads, a business number and an assistant for missed calls
- [Pricing](https://getworkbuddy.com/pricing): $297 a month, everything included, no contract, with answers to common questions
- [Customers](https://getworkbuddy.com/customers): Real client results, measured from Google and WorkBuddy's records, names hidden
- [Industries](https://getworkbuddy.com/industries): Pages for 44 kinds of local business, with real Google search volumes
- [Company](https://getworkbuddy.com/company): About WorkBuddy and its founder, Caleb Benedict
- [Careers](https://getworkbuddy.com/careers): Open roles
- [Apply for a call](https://getworkbuddy.com/apply): See if your business qualifies
- [Blog](https://getworkbuddy.com/blog)

## What's included in the Page One Package

- ChatGPT and AI search: the business set up so ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google's AI answers can find it and recommend it by name
- An AI receptionist: a business phone number with an assistant that answers the calls the owner misses, day or night
- Instant replies to new leads: every website lead gets a text back within seconds, in the business's name
- Review requests: automated review requests to the business's customers (WorkBuddy never filters, hides or buys reviews)
- The Google Business Profile, actively managed: fully built out, new posts every week, every review answered within a day
- The website, rebuilt to rank: fast, mobile-ready, with a page for every service the business offers, a lead form and hosting
- SEO for the first page of Google: local keyword and competitor research, every service page optimized, a new article every week
- Listings: accurate, matching details on major directories such as Yelp, Apple Maps, Bing Maps and the BBB
- A dedicated account manager the owner can text any time, and a dashboard to see results

## Key facts

- Price: $297 a month. No contract, no setup fee, cancel any month
- WorkBuddy does not sell leads. The calls go straight to the business, not to a shared list
- What stays the owner's: the domain (registered in their name), the Google Business Profile (WorkBuddy is only added as a manager), the phone number and reviews, and the website, from day one
- Reach: 1,644 businesses worked with across 49 states and 87 kinds of local business
- Founder: Caleb Benedict. Based in Massachusetts
- Contact: caleb@getworkbuddy.com
